title: Welcome Coach: Compact Guided Tour + Checklist Cards for Console First-Run
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, low-friction "Welcome Coach" tour for first-time Console users. Deliver a stack of reusable checklist cards, microcopy variants, empty-state illustration sets, and a set of 10 annotated screenshots ready for engineering and docs. The coach flows should prioritize discoverability for Dedicated/Private features without overwhelming new users: progressive reveal, dismiss/pause controls, and quick checklist completion that maps to backend onboarding events. Assets must include light/dark variants, small-screen responsive crops, and PNG + SVG exports for documentation and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 8 checklist card components (Figma frames) with responsive variants: desktop, tablet, and narrow mobile.
10 annotated screenshots exported at 2x (light/dark) with filenames matching release naming conventions.
Microcopy approved by PM and localization lead, with 2 RU/ES variants stubbed for i18n handoff.
Engineering sign-off on CSS token mapping and tooltip timing behavior documented in handoff.
Accessibility audit notes implemented: contrast, screenreader labels, focus order documented.
screenshot_notes: Include redwood console header in frame for context. Avoid showing real customer names - use placeholder org: Acme Inc.
Crop to 1280x720 for release notes hero; include inset magnifier annotations as separate layer.
Dark mode screenshots must be validated against contrast guidelines (WCAG AA).
microcopy_variants: Tooltip: 'This helps us optimize your default model routing'
Empty state header: 'No API keys yet' - body: 'Create one to start sending requests to the Redwood API.'
Checklist item copy: 'Connect a model · Generate an API key · Run sample prompt'
discussion_notes: 2026-03-10 - Asha Patel: Initial ticket created. Attached first sketches and suggested checklist flow. Goal to reduce initial time-to-first-success to under 6 minutes.
2026-03-11 - Lina Gomez: Iterated on card density; proposing compact cards with progress chips. Uploaded compact-card-variants.fig.
2026-03-12 - Marcus Chen (Eng): Confirmed that tooltip timing (500ms delay -> persist 30s) is implementable without runtime perf cost. Requested CSS token mapping before handoff.
2026-03-12 - Priya Nair (PM): PM review - prefer stronger emphasis on Dedicated onboarding path for users from sales-led activation. Asked for an opt-in toggle to surface Dedicated checklist first.
2026-03-13 - Accessibility review (Jared Lee): Suggested adding aria-live announcements when checklist items complete; proposed focus trapping behavior for modals. Marked a11y:high priority.
2026-03-14 - Design crit (team): Approved visual direction with minor spacing tweaks. Action: produce final export set and annotated handoff doc.

Links: confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ONBOARD/Welcome+Coach+Spec, github PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/982, figma prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/WelcomeCoach/Console-Prototype
handoff_checklist: Export final SVG/PNG sets (light/dark) and place in Drive asset folder.
Create mapping table of component tokens -> CSS variables and pass to ENG.
Upload annotated screenshots into release-notes folder with alt-text drafts.
Submit PR with style tokens and a small demo harness page (ENG partner: Marcus Chen).
Book handoff meeting with ENG + PM + Localization for 30 minutes.
qa_tests: Verify checklist completion emits onboarding events: onboarding.checklist.item_completed
Verify dismiss/pause persists across sessions (local storage + server flag for logged-in users).
Validate screenshots show placeholder org names and no PII.
Verify light/dark exports match approved color tokens and iconography.
Run Lighthouse a11y snapshot on the demo harness page and fix critical issues.
accessibility_notes: All CTA buttons require accessible names and focus-visible states.
Use aria-describedby on checklist items that have tips; tips must be reachable via keyboard.
Ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 for small text and 3:1 for large text per WCAG guidelines.
Provide screenreader-only summary when the coach first appears: 'Welcome Coach: a 3-step setup checklist'.
